name: Season Change
overview: Scripture reveals that God has established seasons as part of His divine order, appointing celestial bodies like the sun and moon to mark times for various purposes (Genesis 1:14; Psalms 104:19). These seasons are consistent and purposeful, encompassing cycles such as seedtime and harvest, summer and winter, which will continue as long as the earth remains (Genesis 8:22). Believers are encouraged to recognize that everything has its appointed time under heaven, and in God's perfect timing, all things are made beautiful and purposeful (Ecclesiastes 3:1, 3:11). This understanding invites trust in God's sovereign control over the rhythms of life and His provision for growth and fruitfulness in due season (Psalms 1:3).
